predictions.G7_0: confirm7 上的基算子单向 R_2N ≥ 0.95，范围包括：BART weekday/month 的 RRR-16、T5Gemma month 的 RRR-16，以及四个多句式组合的 S-RRR-16。name3 上 Tok-U 的 R_6 ≥ 0.95。不通过即停止排查。
predictions.R0: 全部案例。正对照：R-A 的 SNAP ≥ 0.90；R-B 的 SNAP+CTX ≥ 0.95。不满足则该族不可解释，只报告数字。
predictions.R1: （主）R-A（T5Gemma）。H-offhull：PROJ ≥ 0.70 且 PUSH ≤ 0.40；H-inspan：PUSH ≥ 0.70 且 PROJ ≤ 0.40；两者都 ≥ 0.70 为"任一即可"；两者都 ≤ 0.40 为"都不是"。
predictions.R2: （主）R-B。H-inspan：PUSH ≥ 0.70，且 PROJ、CTX ≤ 0.40；H-context：CTX ≥ 0.70 且 PUSH ≤ 0.40；H-offhull：PROJ ≥ 0.70 且 PUSH ≤ 0.40；其他为混合，报告全部修复率。
predictions.R3: （主）对照步。PROJ、PUSH、CTX 修复后仍成功的比例都 ≥ 0.97（修复本身不破坏正常输入）。
predictions.R4: （主）复现案例。判定与 R1、R2 相同才算"确认"；不同则报告为"不稳定"。
predictions.U1: （主）F1。逐 world 一致率的提升（U − 只看槽位）CI 下界 > 0，且 U 的类别准确率 ≥ 0.85。
predictions.U3: （主）NI。一致率下降 ≤ 0.01，且差值 CI 下界 > −0.02。
predictions.U4: （次）各族。U 预测失败的精确率 ≥ 0.90；F3 的提升；次版本阈值在 F2 上的结果。
predictions.Q21: H-fix：U1、U2、U3 都成立。部分：U3 成立，且 U1、U2 只成立一个；报告是哪一族。H-nofix：其他情形。
predictions.A1: （主，只看潜变量）F∅ 链上的离流形程度 ρ。H-cycle：交替与单向 plus 在 t = 2N 时 ρ 中位数之比 ≥ 2；单向 plus 在 t = N 与 t = 1 时之比 ≤ 1.5。4 个组合中至少 3 个成立。
predictions.A2: （主，干净输入上的一阶误差，附录 A.7）一圈和比；交替对比。H-cycle：一圈和比的中位数 ≤ 0.25，且交替对比的中位数 ≥ 0.50。至少 3/4。
predictions.A3: （主）用 P⁻¹ 作 minus 算子时，单向 minus 的 R_2N。每个组合 ≥ 0.95。
predictions.A3b: （次）(P, P⁻¹) 交替的 R_2N。≥ 0.95。这几乎由构造决定，只作对照。
predictions.Q22: H-cycle：A1、A2、A3 都成立。只有 A3 成立：写成"互逆配对有效，但累积机制未确认"。其他情形：按成立的部分报告。
predictions.K5: （主）Att2L-U8 的单向 R_100。H-closed：中位数 ≥ 0.90，且 ≥ 4/5 个 seed 不低于 0.80；H-slow-decay：中位数 ≤ 0.50。
predictions.K6: （主）三种编辑器的 R_30。支持方：Att2L-U8 中 ≥ 0.90 的 seed 至少 4/5，且 Att2L-U4 与 Att1-U8 的中位数都 ≤ 0.50；对立方：Att2L-U8 的中位数 ≤ 0.50。
predictions.K7: （主）OR-U8 的 R_30。H-representable：中位数 ≥ 0.90；H-unrepresentable：中位数 ≤ 0.50。
predictions.K8: （主）Att2L-U8（8 个 seed）删掉第 2 层注意力项后的 R_30（附录 A.8 的 c）。H-layer2-needed：中位数 ≤ 0.50；H-layer2-redundant：中位数 ≥ 0.90。
predictions.K9: （次）name3、bind3fix 上 Att2L-U8 的 R_30。不低于 0.95 的 seed ≥ 6/8。

operational.general: Paths start at the world start; 2N steps (plus, minus, alternating plus/minus). R_k = fraction of worlds whose decoded output is a success at every step 1..k (template 0 / 3: v1-v6 scorer; multi-template: exact match after whitespace normalisation). Categories: composable >= 0.90, fail <= 0.20, else partial. CIs: world cluster bootstrap, 2000 reps, seed 3101 (paired for differences); world = (domain, world_id). Identical cells (same continuous latent trajectories: m and rho of the locked simulation) are detected before any CI and only the first of each group is counted (design rule 10). Primary predictions decide; secondary ones are reported separately (rule 6).
operational.U_rule: Predictors on the locked simulation (results/simulate_<bb>.json.gz): slot-only = readout equals gold at every step; U = readout equals gold, m >= tau_m and rho <= tau_r at every step, thresholds of results/calib_u_<bb>.json (primary for U1-U3; secondary reported in U4). Per family, pooled per-world agreement (prediction vs observed chain success at 2N) over the (world, cell) records; category accuracy over cells (predicted rate vs observed R_2N). F1 = BART template-0 new C3 seeds 45-47 (all snapshots, all paths); F2 = T5Gemma month-mt held-out-template surgeries; NI = BART template-0 v6 CT2 set and T5Gemma month template-0 set (cells7.py). U1 (F1) and U2 (F2) hold iff the paired CI of (U - slot) agreement has lower bound > 0 and U category accuracy >= 0.85. U3 holds iff on the NI set of each backbone (U - slot) >= -0.01 and its CI lower bound > -0.02. U4 (secondary): precision of a U-predicted failure per family (>= 0.90); the (U - slot) gain on F3; the secondary thresholds on F2. Q21: H-fix iff U1, U2, U3; partial iff U3 and exactly one of U1, U2; else H-nofix. If the B7 pre-check fails, U1 and U2 are exploratory and Q21 is reported descriptively.
operational.R_rule: Cases: data/r_cases.json (P3, frozen; v6 confirm6) and R4 replication cases drawn after the lock from this experiment's U chains by the same rules (r_repair.r4_cases). Each repair is applied once at the case step and decoded once; success = exact match with the gold state of that step. Rates pooled over the group's cases; R1 on R-A-t5 (69 cases); R2 on R-B pooled over the families that pass R0 (per family reported); R3 on all control steps (PROJ, PUSH on every control; CTX where applicable). R4: R4-A-t5 with the R1 rule, R4-B with the R2 rule; confirmed iff the verdict equals R1 resp. R2, else unstable. A repair whose pre-check median change ||h' - h|| / R_w < 0.02 in a group is a no-op there; predictions resting on it become exploratory. CIs: world cluster bootstrap.
operational.A_rule: Four combinations: BART weekday-mt, month-mt, hour-mt, T5Gemma month-mt (confirm7, held-out templates); P = v6 GM S-RRR-16. A1 from the locked simulation (F_empty chains): per combination ratio median rho(alt, t = 2N) / median rho(plus, t = 2N) >= 2 and median rho(plus, t = N) / median rho(plus, t = 1) <= 1.5; holds iff >= 3 of the combinations that passed the pre-check (dev7-ho alt median rho at 2N >= 0.02) hold, and at least 3 passed (else A1 exploratory). A2 (a_cycle.py on confirm7 clean inputs): per combination median cycle-sum ratio <= 0.25 and median alternating contrast >= 0.50; holds iff >= 3/4. A3: one-way minus with P^-1 R_2N >= 0.95 on every combination whose inverse passed the A.6 pre-check (cond < 1e3, round trip < 1e-5). A3b (secondary): (P, P^-1) alternating R_2N >= 0.95. A1 and A2 are computed only after the lock.
operational.K_rule: bind3; decisions use the new seeds 45-49 (5 seeds; OR-U8: 42-44); all 8 seeds reported; a seed that could not learn counts as R = 0. K5: H-closed iff median R_100 >= 0.90 and >= 4/5 seeds >= 0.80; H-slow-decay iff median <= 0.50; else mixed. K6: holds iff >= 4/5 Att2L-U8 seeds have R_30 >= 0.90 and the medians of Att2L-U4 and Att1-U8 are <= 0.50; opposing iff the Att2L-U8 median <= 0.50; else mixed. K7: OR-U8 median R_30 >= 0.90 H-representable, <= 0.50 H-unrepresentable, else mixed. K8 (8 seeds, ablation c): median R_30 <= 0.50 H-layer2-needed, >= 0.90 H-layer2-redundant, else mixed; exploratory if the pre-check shows it decided by construction. K9 (secondary): name3 and bind3fix Att2L-U8 R_30 >= 0.95 in >= 6/8 seeds.
operational.oracle: OR-U8 (oracle routing) is a diagnostic, never a usable editor; it differs from v6 OR-U4 only in the unroll set S <= 8 and the number of updates (design rule 4).
operational.paper: PLAN v7 B12 maps every outcome (including mixed and neither) to the paper text.
